summary: Ellomay Capital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching its June 2026 investor presentation. The filing is a routine disclosure of a presentation, not a special situation. No transaction, activist event, strategic review, or corporate action is announced. The presentation contains forward-looking statements and disclaims any offer of securities. As a foreign private issuer, Form 6-K serves the equivalent of a U.S. Form 8-K for current information. The filing provides no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. What to watch: an investor presentation may precede a capital raise or M&A, but this filing alone is nonevent.
